clips.title: The story
paras: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle sends Alliance recruits along Southshore's coast to prove his patrol's success. Marshal Redpath wants evidence that the murlocs have been cleared from the Western Strand.

After the first coastal sweeps in Down the Coast, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle faces scrutiny from Marshal Redpath and Southshore's leaders. Farren claims the local murlocs have been cleared, but his superiors want proof. He leaves the grim work to wandering Alliance adventurers and sends them back to the shore for evidence of the kills.

The Western Strand lies west of Southshore, where coastal murlocs live along the shallows. Farren asks for ten severed murloc heads to satisfy the garrison's officers. He detests the creatures and says their repulsive sight and smell have ruined his appetite for Southshore's chief export and staple food.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Redpath wasn't satisfied with all the murlocs we killed—oh now, don't be modest, you had some hand in it.
Now he wants me to bring proof of the dead, hacking off cold, slimy murloc heads to submit for his approval.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get those heads for me, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh for the Love of the Light... They're dripping on the ground.
Can't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around...
Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in Southshore, that means you aren't eating much.
